site_name: Land Between Whitefield Avenue And Claremont RoadBrent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration AreaNorth West LondonNW2
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
description: Submission of details pursuant to the discharge of condition 1.8 (temporary works) comprising construction of a temporary parking area, vehicular and pedestrian access from whitefield avenue and associated works serving the southern development including the short-term provision of a multi-use games area on part of the temporary parking area situated on land between whitefield avenue and claremont road and pursuant to condition 1.8a comprising hoarding to the above of planning permission F/04687/13 dated 23/07/2014 for the comprehensive redevelopment of Brent Cross Cricklewood.
